title: Fruit Fly
description: Go gay. Go sad. Go dark.A washed-up author will stop at nothing to claw her way back to relevancy - even if it means appropriating a young gay man’s tragic story.Mallory Maddox is buried under seven years of writer’s block. With her status as a literary sensation fizzling, she’ll do anything she can to resurrect her career. Inspiration needs to strike - and fast.Enter Leo. He’s a struggling addict sleeping under b...
